main_text.l: Rerum & Locorum Scripturæ, quæ hoc li-
Ecce agnus ille Dei, qui tollit peccatum mundi.

page.notes: The numeral in the title reads "CLXXX." in the scan, printed with a bar over it; transcribed as printed in the image, with the last letters as they appear. The woodcut shows a tree and a figure with a small city behind; no text in it. Hyphens at line ends are printed hyphens. The "&" is the printed ampersand-like sign (Et ligature) before "Locorum". Two heading lines are set as lines of a title page, so no head element is used.
